summary: Tune En UI application compositions toward comfortable operational density and add a complete anti-slop prevention catalog for generated interfaces without shrinking readable type, controls, focus treatment, or narrow-screen gutters.

components: Add optional comfortable and compact composition density to PageSection and SplitLayout while reusing PageContainer's existing gutter choices and preserving current public behavior.
consumers: Ship the complete anti-slop catalog with the en-ui-consumer skill and require it for generated pages and material visual reviews.
Extend deterministic consumer checks only for high-confidence source patterns; keep layout defects in rendered validation and contextual judgments in human review.
contracts: Add approved density declarations for PageSection and SplitLayout while retaining all existing variants and anatomy.
documentation: Document comfortable-density values, surface-flattening rules, anti-slop exceptions, enforcement tiers, and the Impeccable source-version discrepancy.
foundations: Reuse the existing tight, related, section, and page spacing roles; add no raw spacing, type, color, radius, or shadow values.
patterns: Use Service Operations and AI Release Review as the representative slice: reduce repeated page gaps, flatten unnecessary surfaces, remove routine eyebrow labels and side-tab accents, and keep the primary work visible early.
screenshots: Capture candidate narrow, medium, and wide screenshots for the two representative stories; do not update visual baselines without explicit human approval.
